_note: Fictional RFP. Harbourview Council does not exist.

blocks.p: Harbourview Council seeks a hosted records management platform for its planning department.
The vendor shall encrypt all customer data at rest and in transit.
The vendor must rotate encryption keys at least every 12 months.
The vendor shall store all data within Australia.
The vendor must hold FedRAMP High authorisation.

table: The vendor must provide 24/7 support with a Severity 1 response time of 30 minutes or better.
The vendor shall provide a named service delivery manager.
How will Council staff sign in using the Council's Microsoft Entra ID tenant?
The vendor must supply three customer references, including contact details.

blocks.p: Proposals are scored on technical approach (40 percent), delivery (30 percent) and price (30 percent).
Each answer shall be no longer than 200 words.
Responses must be submitted by 30 November 2026 through the Council tender portal.
One electronic copy in PDF format shall be uploaded to the portal.
